purpose: English-only public development candidates extending intervention, long-term policy, participatory inquiry and teacher-education coverage. These are screening questions, not endorsements of whole-article writing quality. Acquisition, full reading and analysis are separate stages; none is a final holdout.

sources.title: Effects of double-dose algebra on college persistence and degree attainment
sources.selection_question: How does the article carry a local policy comparison into long-term educational outcomes while explaining cohort differences and implementation? Check whether composition and treatment comparisons retain their distinct identification assumptions.
sources.version_note: Public PMC full text of the 2021 PNAS article. Related earlier double-dose algebra reports concern the same policy and cohorts; do not count them as independent replications.

sources.title: Reducing socioeconomic disparities in the STEM pipeline through student emotion regulation
sources.selection_question: How does an emotion-regulation account motivate a brief classroom intervention and connect exam performance with course progression? Inspect the handling of subgroup comparisons, proposed mechanisms and practical importance.
sources.version_note: University repository copy of the 2019 PNAS article; original states CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Source PDF remains outside this repository; publish original analysis and links only.

sources.title: A Case Study of Participatory Action Research in a Public New England Middle School: Empowerment, Constraints and Challenges
sources.selection_question: How does a participatory inquiry preserve the educational commitment to empowerment alongside constraints encountered in school? Verify the actual evidence, participant roles and analytic genre before inclusion.
sources.version_note: Publisher identifies open access. Exact version, permission and complete reading await acquisition; access failure must remain visible.

sources.title: Building pre-service teachers’ resilience through Service-Learning: an explanatory sequential mixed methods study
sources.selection_question: How do accounts of service-learning experiences explain the dimensions of resilience measured in teacher education? Check the connection between participants, the joint display and the strength of claims about change.
sources.version_note: PDF and XML links observed on the public publisher page. Actual empirical integration and writing moves still require full reading.

sources.title: The student voice in well-being: a case study of participatory action research in positive education
sources.selection_question: How are students' participation in inquiry, accounts of the process and measured outcomes connected? Verify whether integration changes the account of student voice rather than merely adding measurements to a case narrative.
sources.version_note: Online publication 2018, volume 27 issue 2 in 2019. Author publication list confirms identity; candidate PDF URL was located through a public citation to the author's site and requires content verification.
